name: codex-subagent-dsh
description: Delegate bounded local tasks from Codex to a running DeepSeek Harness instance while Codex keeps routing and acceptance responsibility.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded local tasks to DSH
interface.longDescription: A community MCP plugin that lets the main Codex agent submit bounded local work to a running DeepSeek Harness instance, inspect task state, retrieve results, and request cancellation while retaining final verification responsibility.
